verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A platform, so letting an agent edit forecasts or scenarios through a documented machine interface is a fair question. The evidence does not show it. The built-in Aleph Agent updates reports and dashboards through Slack or the UI, not forecasts or scenarios through a documented API. All OpenAPI probe paths returned 404, and "anything with an API" refers to inbound data connectors. Audit logs are mentioned only generically, with nothing tying agent edits to the same trail as human edits.
